Ethan: Quick ping - we have GreenByte ready for a short case vignette tied to our benchmark deep-dive. Want to confirm interview logistics, legal signoff cadence, and lead routing. Draft brief: https://intranet.redwood/greenbyte (request access if you need it)

Rae: I can schedule. Do we want a live demo clip? GreenByte prefers recorded interview only.

Maya: OK for recorded only. Let's aim for a 25-min interview and capture a 1-2 sentence technical quote and a 1-sentence business outcome quote.

Ethan: Timeline - webinar = 2024-11-28. Legal needs final quotes by 2024-11-20. Marketing needs final approved by 2024-11-22.

LegalBot: Please add exact quote lines to the doc. Legal requires: data-use consent, embargo period, and confirmation if any anonymized logs will be included. Send approval emails to legal@redwood.com. Redlines must be returned within 48 hours.

Rae: Added calendar options and a short interview guide to the doc. Recording is okay and we'll capture transcript.

Maya: Ops numbers needed: avg latency, peak throughput, and cost per 10k tokens. Ops, can you verify?

OpsBot: Looping in Lila. Lila will add verified numbers and sign off.
